# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.23

A visual refresh — new icons and logo throughout the app — plus a small reliability fix for cover art downloads.

### What's new

- **Fresh app icon and logo.** MeedyaDL's app icon, system tray icon, and in-app logo all got a brand refresh — you'll notice it in your dock/taskbar and system tray after updating.

### What's fixed

- **Cover art downloads are a little more reliable.** An upstream GAMDL update adds a proper timeout and automatic retry when fetching artwork, cutting down on occasional failures.

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
